chief_complaint.chief_complaint: Requesting removal of lower right wisdom teeth

present_illness.present_illness: The right lower back tooth had been swollen and painful repeatedly for several months. X-rays were taken at another hospital and now he comes to our hospital for consultation.

past_history.present_illness: The right lower back tooth had been swollen and painful repeatedly for several months. X-rays were taken at another hospital and now he comes to our hospital for consultation.

oral_examination.oral_examination: 48 The lower right wisdom tooth partially erupted inside the mouth, covering a large area of ​​gums, and there was no redness or swelling in the gums.

treatment_plan.notes: Avoid acidic foods within a week and avoid hot and cold stimulation. Maintain oral hygiene as directed by your doctor and rinse with mouthwash. Regular re-examination and follow-up treatment if any discomfort occurs.
